primary.why: New Cycle is a Windows city-building survival game from Core Engage and Daedalic Entertainment. It is still in Early Access, with planned full-version additions such as more maps/biomes, additional modes, outpost expansion, and broader narrative content. No console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is the only route, but the archive recommendation is provisional until 1.0.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam Early Access build only if an in-development archive capture is acceptable; otherwise wait for 1.0 and revalidate.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC Early Access release and the only sourced platform route.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform; provisional until full release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform split was found; the important caveat is Early Access status.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access game: revalidate at 1.0 before treating this as a final definitive archive route. Supporter Pack and soundtrack are optional extras, not gameplay-complete DLC.
